values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 382 sites in Areas 1-7 and 6X: 185 standard non-electric sites rated 35 ft and about 130 pop-up/tent sites rated 25 ft, all back-in, so a 23-ft rig fits most of them. Area 5 runs smaller (6 of its sites are 20 ft or less). Also yurts and group sites.

note: MA DCR state park in Brewster on Cape Cod: wooded campground in pine and oak forest around kettle ponds (swimming and canoeing at Flax and Cliff Ponds; Big Cliff Pond 10 HP limit), with an 8-mile bike path joining the Cape Cod Rail Trail. Cape Cod Bay is within biking distance. --Claude
